text:
jordan.sales: Heads-up team: NimbusBank sent a formal vendor packet request. They want SOC2 evidence, an ISO excerpt, and a pen-test attestation they can include in procurement. Also asked if they can run an authenticated scan during the POC. Any constraints?
mira.se: We can produce a SOC 2 Type II cover letter and a bridge letter if the report is slightly out of date. ISO: scope statement + certificate page only. Pen-test: we provide a signed attestation and a short executive summary of findings, never raw reports.
kevin.security: +1. For authenticated scans we only allow them on dedicated or isolated staging endpoints with an approved test plan and IP allowlist. We require a supervised window and an NDA addendum. We also insist on no destructive testing and rate limits.
jordan.sales: NimbusBank specifically asked for evidence to go into their procurement portal (SFTP upload preferred). They flagged data residency concerns and want confirmation of KMS usage.
toni.ops: I can provision a presigned S3 upload (time-limited) and hand off an SFTP wrapper if they insist. I need the legal entity name and the list of recipient emails. For KMS statement we have a standard controls one-pager.
kevin.security: Send them the KMS controls summary. If they press for screenshots of consoles/HSM, we refuse screenshots; provide a controls narrative and attestations only.
mira.se: Pricing note: standard enterprise POC includes the evidence pack (SOC2 cover + ISO excerpt + attestation). Anything requiring legal sign-off, redaction, or on-site/supervised test support should be quoted as SOW. Typical small SOW for supervised scan + redaction starts ~ $7k.
jordan.sales: Please draft a minimal checklist I can paste into the procurement portal. Needs to be concise.
kevin.security: Copy/paste checklist below: 
```
- SOC 2 Type II: cover letter / bridge letter (PDF excerpt; no audit working papers)
- ISO 27001: certificate page + scope statement (redacted industry-irrelevant assets)
- Pen-test attestation: signed letter + 1-page exec summary (no raw reports)
- KMS & encryption controls one-pager
- High-level network diagram (redacted; no hostnames/IPs)
- Pre-scan requirements: source IPs, test window, scope (staging/dedicated), signed NDA addendum
- Upload instructions: presigned S3 link or SFTP details
- Contact for compliance SOW / supervised-test quote
```
kevin.security: Lead times: 2-4 business days for standard pack, 7-12 for legal sign-off or custom redaction.
toni.ops: I can create the presigned S3 bucket today once I have recipient emails. artifact-bot: Created ticket #INC-5521 for NimbusBank evidence request.
jordan.sales: NimbusBank legal name: "Nimbus Bank Holdings, LLC". They prefer SFTP. I'll ask for test IPs and preferred windows.
mira.se: Also add sentence we do not share raw vulnerability scan reports or internal audit workpapers. If they require raw scan artifacts, we can consider a supervised transfer under SOW but default is no.
jordan.sales: Great. I'll send this and loop in Nimbus security. Thanks everyone.
artifact-bot: File attached: /compliance/evidence/nimbus-presign-request.log (internal).
